messages:
Ben (Finance Ops): Heads up — Reseller partner BrightDeck (CUST-15500) called: they were billed a merchant processing fee twice on the same payout for June. Net they were underpaid $420. Invoice INV-2026-0901 shows two "merchant_fee" lines. Need to issue a correction and decide whether to refund to card or post an AR adjustment to their partner balance. Ticket: https://partners.redwood/t/2219
payments-bot: Automated check: payout POUT-2026-667 completed 2026-09-12 14:02 UTC. Duplicate fee detected by rule X-dup-fee-check. Created billing task BT-2026-980.
Clara (RevOps): Can you paste the payout excerpt? We need to reconcile with partner ledger and check if this was absorbed on our side or passed to partner.
Ben (Finance Ops): Payout excerpt:
``
Payout: POUT-2026-667
Gross: 12,400.00
Merchant fee: -210.00
Merchant fee: -210.00  <-- duplicate
Net paid: 11,980.00
```
Clearly duplicated. Partner expects cash reimbursement of $210 x 2? Actually underpaid $420 total but they want immediate refund. Also need GL for the reversal. @Sophie?
Sophie (Billing): Accounting preference: post a refund/adjustment to partner payable then issue a refund to their linked bank (ACH) or apply as credit against next payout. For partners, we usually do payout adjustments (negative fee reimbursed on next payout) unless partner explicitly requests immediate ACH. GL for merchant fee reimbursements is 6401 (Partner Adjustments). We'll need approval for ACH if they request immediate payment >$250.
Marcus (Accounting): Confirm GL 6401 is fine. Also note we need to post a journal entry to reverse the duplicated fee and update the revenue recognition memo if fees were recognized as expense. Suggest: post JE reversing the second fee and create a clearing entry. If refunding now, record REF-2026-621 and associate with payout.
Elena (CS): Partner sent an email asking for immediate ACH reimbursement — their payroll is tomorrow and they need funds. They've provided bank details on file and asked for expedited handling. CC: account owner.
Ben (Finance Ops): Given partner urgency and amount $420 < $5k, I'm ok with ACH same-day if Marcus signs off. Marcus, can you approve REF-2026-621 for $420 to bank on file and we'll tag it to payout POUT-2026-667?
Marcus (Accounting): Approve REF-2026-621. Please ensure we capture the duplicate fee evidence and include the payout ID in the memo. I also need a short justification for audit.
Sophie (Billing): I'll process split: REF-2026-621 (ACH $420) for immediate reimbursement and post CM-2026-1620 to document the reversal in AR/partner ledger (GL 6401). Draft ledger entries below and will attach to task:
```
Date: 2026-09-13
Account: 6401 - Partner Adjustments
Partner: CUST-15500 (BrightDeck)
Amount: -420.00
Memo: Duplicate merchant fee reversal on POUT-2026-667 / INV-2026-0901
Reference: CM-2026-1620

Date: 2026-09-13
Account: REF-Account - Payments Clearing
Partner: CUST-15500 (BrightDeck)
Amount: -420.00
Memo: ACH refund REF-2026-621 tied to POUT-2026-667
Reference: REF-2026-621
```
Sophie (Billing): Processing REF-2026-621 to bank on file now. Payment processor ETA same-day (expedite). Audit links will be attached when complete.
payments-bot: REF-2026-621 initiated via payments gateway; expedite flag set. Processor ETA: same business day.
Marcus (Accounting): Posted CM-2026-1620 in AR. GL 6401 used, memo included. Also updated the payout reconciliation file and marked the duplicate fee flag for the payout. Audit link: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1620.
Ben (Finance Ops): Notifying partner and CS: "We've initiated an ACH reimbursement of $420 for the duplicated merchant fee on POUT-2026-667. REF-2026-621 is processing and should land same business day. We've posted a credit memo CM-2026-1620 for your partner ledger. Sorry for the disruption."
Elena (CS): Partner replied :thumbsup: and thanked us for the quick turnaround. They confirmed bank would reconcile and will reply once funds hit.
Clara (RevOps): Also creating ENG ticket ENG-5692 to add an additional dedupe check upstream in the payout pipeline and to add an alert if duplicate fee lines occur for the same payout. Linking BT-2026-980.
Marcus (Accounting): One small ask for ops: include the original payout export and gateway trace IDs in the CM and REF attachments for audit. I attached them to CM-2026-1620.
Sophie (Billing): Done. REF cleared by payments gateway and funds pending settlement. Posting complete on our side. Audit refs: https://audit.redwood/ref/REF-2026-621, https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1620.
payments-bot: Task BT-2026-980 closed. ENG-5692 created and assigned.
Ben (Finance Ops): Closing loop — refund processed, partner notified, accounting entries posted, ENG ticket created to prevent recurrence. Marking resolved from finance side. :white_check_mark:
